visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a white dress stands in front of a weathered red brick wall with pigeons perched on its turrets. She smiles and reaches out her hand as if holding someone's hand from a first-person perspective. The lighting is bright natural daylight under a blue sky. (2) A series of rapid jump cuts shows the woman in various scenic locations in Chiang Mai, including wooden pavilions and ancient temples with golden pagodas. She maintains the POV hand-holding pose throughout, spinning and smiling with joyful expressions. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of an airplane cabin. The woman walks down the aisle between red and black seats. She turns back to the camera with a cheerful look. The lighting is bright and even indoor cabin lighting. (4) Close-up shots focus on her legs and the seat space, demonstrating the generous legroom. She points at her legs and gives two thumbs up while seated. (5) A table tray is shown with various Thai-style airplane meals, including rice dishes, sausages, salad, and a green drink. Handheld camera movements emphasize the variety of the food. (6) The woman is shown eating a yellow noodle dish from a foil container using a white plastic fork. She looks at the camera with an appreciative expression while chewing. (7) Close-up shots of a Thai milk tea in a green cup with 'santan' branding. It contains ice and boba pearls. The woman takes a sip through a black straw and smiles broadly. (8) The woman visits a large traditional temple and walks through a street decorated with numerous colorful lanterns hanging overhead. She is wearing a white cardigan over a light-colored dress and carrying a black handbag. (9) At a night venue, a performer on stage handles fire in front of a crowd. This is followed by a group of performers in red outfits dancing on a stage under vibrant club lighting. (10) The woman sits in a garden setting at night, gently petting a black cat. The lighting is warm and soft, creating a relaxed atmosphere.

(2) A cheerful female voice-over in Traditional Chinese enters, describing the travel experience with AirAsia. Her tone is friendly and enthusiastic, with clear articulation. The BGM continues as a steady, rhythmic layer underneath. (3) A subtle shift in the acoustic environment occurs during the airplane cabin scenes, with a very faint low-frequency hum suggestive of a pressurized cabin, though the BGM and narration remain primary. (4) An intentional 'pop' or 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition to food shots. The narrator's pitch rises slightly when expressing excitement about the meals. (5) During the eating sequence, short, stylized chewing sound effects ('ah-mu') are audible, synchronized with the visual action. (6) The crowd's cheering and clapping sounds swell during the fire show and dance sequence, providing an immersive spatial layer. (7) The video concludes with the narrator expressing overall satisfaction, her voice maintaining high valence and arousal, ending on a final rising intonation as the music fades out.
